As Dr Pepper Snapple Group (DPS) Share Price Rose, Lindsell Train LTD Has Raised Position; Capital Wealth Planning Has Cut Its Position in Lowes Companies (LOW) by $2.56 Million
May 17, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
Lindsell Train Ltd increased its stake in Dr Pepper Snapple Group Inc (DPS) by 23.76% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Lindsell Train Ltd bought 618,500 shares as the company’s stock rose 23.05% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 3.22 million shares of the consumer non-durables company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $312.74 million, up from 2.60 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Lindsell Train Ltd who had been investing in Dr Pepper Snapple Group Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $21.45 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.28% or $0.34 during the last trading session, reaching $119.03. About 748,802 shares traded. Dr Pepper Snapple Group, Inc. (NYSE:DPS) has risen 21.65% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 10.10% the S&P500.
Capital Wealth Planning Llc decreased its stake in Lowes Companies Inc (LOW) by 68.14% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Capital Wealth Planning Llc sold 27,804 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.74% with the market. The institutional investor held 13,000 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.21 million, down from 40,804 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Capital Wealth Planning Llc who had been investing in Lowes Companies Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $70.61 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.21% or $0.18 during the last trading session, reaching $85.51. About 3.98 million shares traded. Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE:LOW) has risen 5.39% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 6.16% the S&P500.
